description: This file defines a React functional component named ErroredItems that displays a list of items that failed to decrypt, allowing users to export, delete, or attempt decryption of each item. It handles interactions with application services for messages, file downloads, and decryption attempts, and manages local component state for the list of errored items.

methods.name: getContentTypeDisplay
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the content type of an encrypted item.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a single encrypted item after user confirmation.

methods.name: deleteItems
methods.description: Deletes multiple encrypted items after user confirmation.

methods.name: attemptDecryption
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt an item, showing an error alert if decryption cannot proceed.
